subject.title: [Feature]: Integrate password toggle functionality across all platforms to let users see password in clear text

question: Should OpenClaw credential reveal state be ephemeral and masked-by-default per field, or may visibility preferences persist across sessions/platforms?
rationale: Showing secrets in clear text changes credential exposure behavior, and the issue's proposed localStorage persistence is a product/security choice rather than a mechanical UI fix.

options.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
options.body: Add per-field reveal controls that reset to masked by default and do not persist visibility across sessions.

options.title: Persist Visibility Preference
options.body: Allow local persistence only after maintainers define the exposure tradeoff, reset behavior, and platform-specific storage boundary.

options.title: Defer Broad Rollout
options.body: Keep the current partial web behavior until maintainers complete a credential-field inventory and platform owner plan.

recommendation.title: Ephemeral Reveal Only
recommendation.body: Add per-field reveal controls that reset to masked by default and do not persist visibility across sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: He already reviewed this issue and has the strongest current routing signal across the affected Control UI and macOS surfaces.
